**Is this in scope?**

Check [CONTRIBUTING.md](../../CONTRIBUTING.md#scope) first — some things
(IP/ASN lookups, availability monitoring, bulk lookups, watch mode,
historical WHOIS archiving, acting as a WHOIS/RDAP server) are explicit
non-goals for now. If your request is one of these, the issue is still
welcome, but flag it as such so the discussion starts from the right
place.
